submission.natural_language_explanation: Retrospective: the pole fires on the token that continues or completes a multi-token licensing frame set up by earlier tokens in the same sentence -- e.g. the complement verb after 'ruled that the <noun>', the 'to' closing a 'from'-range, the second verb after '<action> and', a pronoun continuing a greeting opener, or the consequent noun after 'then the' -- with activation driven by those earlier frame tokens (mean attribution distance ~1.6; single-token swaps of the frame opener collapse it). The same surface token in a bare frame with no licensing context (e.g. 'was' in 'The contract was void.', 'stared' in 'She stared at the wall.', 'at' in 'They arrived at noon.') stays near silent, so the pole tracks frame completion, not token identity.
